meta.name: manage-mounts
meta.description: Configure which host directories agent containers can access. View, add, or remove mount allowlist entries. Triggers on "mounts", "mount allowlist", "agent access to directories", "container mounts".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理容器可访问的主机目录挂载
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要控制 agent 容器能访问哪些主机目录
copy.tagline_en: Manage which host directories agent containers can access
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control which host directories agent containers can access

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 管理主机目录访问列表：查看允许容器访问的目录及读写权限，添加或移除目录。修改后新容器自动生效，无需重启服务。
howto.when: 当你说出“mounts”、“mount allowlist”等触发词，或要求配置代理容器对目录的访问权限时触发。

say.note: 它会读取配置文件并显示目录和读写权限。

say.text: 添加 /data 为容器的可读目录。
say.note: 需确认路径存在，默认只读。

say.text: 把 /tmp 从挂载白名单里移除。
say.note: 它会更新配置，下次生成的容器不再访问。

howto.what_en: Manage the mount allowlist for agent containers: view allowed host directories with read-only/read-write status, add or remove entries. New config applies to newly spawned containers automatically; no service restart needed.
howto.when_en: Triggers on keywords like 'mounts' or 'mount allowlist', or when the user asks to configure container directory access.

say_en.note: Reads the config and displays directories and permissions.

say_en.text: Add /data as a read-only directory for containers.

say_en.note: Updates config; new containers won't access it.
